records.revalidation_trigger: Revalidate when Camarero changes programme publication routes, local/simulcast document structure, or post-time labelling.
limitations: Programme PDFs contain both local Camarero racing and simulcast material, so post times require bounded local-race parsing before automatic A publication.
Conditions, awards, participants, betting, results and full racecard content remain excluded.
records.notes: Reviewed A-capability evidence is preserved. Live GitHub Actions on 2026-10-02 fetched and parsed current official programme PDFs, but automatic production deliberately does not infer all PDF post times because simulcast races share the document.

records.revalidation_trigger: Revalidate when the Camarero Inscripciones route, Spanish date labels, week navigation or physical venue identity changes.
limitations: Automatic publication is limited to official entry dates plus Hipódromo Camarero physical identity at C.
Future week shells with no published entries are an unpublished source horizon, not evidence that racing will not run.
Programme post times remain behind the separate reviewed A-capability path until local Camarero races can be isolated safely from simulcast content.
Source absence is not non-running evidence.
records.notes: Live GitHub Actions on 2026-10-02 fetched the current official Inscripciones page successfully and exposed forthcoming Camarero local race days for October 1-4. The automatic C route preserves the separate reviewed A programme evidence.
